description:
Per-product-class VAT rates (tickets vs merchandise vs lodging vs parking — EU classes differ), tax-inclusive/exclusive display, VAT breakdown lines in the money journal, settlement and invoices. Rates resolve through the TKT-5 rules hierarchy.

**Conditions of Success:**
- Order totals carry per-line VAT at the correct product-class rate; inclusive/exclusive display configurable
- Settlement reports VAT collected per rate and reconciles with the journal to the cent
- Changing a rate never rewrites history — rate versions apply by sale date (ADR-003 discipline)

Lineage: docs/product/brief.md · docs/product/prd-v1.md (capability map). Origin: backlog grilling 2026-07-12.

comments.body: COS defined at epic level; decompose when prioritized (Gate 1). Blind spot found in review: fee splits and settlement were in scope with no tax treatment.
